title: Workspace-GPT: check the room before moving the furniture
summary: Before materialising a large file, extracting a ZIP, running a space-heavy test, or depending on session-local context, inspect byte/inode headroom and preflight the operation. If it cannot fit safely, prepare handover before partial work.
procedure: Run workspace.inspect before large materialisation/extraction/test work.
If a needed attachment is not present, run workspace.materialization.check with the best known expected size; do not invent a sandbox path.
Before ZIP extraction, run workspace.archive.preflight. It reads the central directory without extraction.
Treat HANDOVER_ADVISED as a stop condition for the planned extraction/materialisation in this workspace.
Before expected session loss or when continuity artifacts are missing, run workspace.context.recoverability and prepare handover.
invariants: Do not start extraction merely because the compressed ZIP fits.
Compare total uncompressed bytes and member count against destination bytes and free inodes.
Reject traversal paths and suspicious expansion ratios before extraction.
Leave a configurable reserve rather than consuming the workspace to zero.
A conversation attachment name does not prove that its bytes are mounted in the execution workspace.
When capacity/recoverability is inadequate, record exact artifact identity, current state, active spheres, next task and test evidence before handing over.
